# Evidence
- Problem class: go-websocket-read-deadline-kills-inflight-llm-turn
- Model: openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash
- Solved: 2026-09-12T18:59:12.211Z
- Verification: solution produced by pi in sandbox; see signatures.json

signatures.description: A WebSocket chat handler (coder/websocket) wraps every conn.Read in a short context.WithTimeout (30s). When the client is silently waiting for a long-running LLM/agent turn, the read deadline fires, the read loop returns, and the deferred context cancel SIGKILLs the in-flight worker process (log: agent runner error: exec: signal: killed) so the client never receives an answer. Fix pattern: a single read pump owns all reads with NO deadline; the short read timeout applies only to a turn-less idle connection; a ping loop (interval = readTimeout/2) detects half-open connections during turns; all socket writes are funnelled through one goroutine (single-writer invariant); a second message during a turn is rejected explicitly. Verification: regression test with a fake runner whose delay is a multiple of readTimeout (RED before the fix at 0.10s with EOF, GREEN after), plus a live probe proving a >=40s turn is delivered.
